mechanism: Lopinavir inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing isoniazid metabolism and increasing its levels; isoniazid may induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing lopinavir concentrations.
action: Monitor for isoniazid toxicity (peripheral neuropathy, hepatotoxicity); consider isoniazid dose reduction or alternative antituberculous regimen; monitor lopinavir levels and viral load.
